bugs: Search LIKE does not escape % and _ wildcards: ?q=% matches every product (app/Models/Product.php:50) - minor
antipatterns: Policy method viewAny used to gate all admin actions incl. create/update/delete - misleading name (app/Policies/ProductPolicy.php:9, routes/web.php:15)
Filter errors are rendered twice: an error summary plus each field's @error from x-field (resources/views/products/index.blade.php:4-10 + components/field.blade.php:5)
'page' validated as integer min:1 on a public GET, so ?page=0 bounces with a validation error instead of Laravel's lenient default (app/Http/Requests/IndexProductRequest.php:19)
Filter form reads request('q') / request('category') directly in the view instead of using validated values (resources/views/products/index.blade.php:14,20)
strengths: Thin controllers: query scopes (active/search/inCategory/sortedBy with #[Scope]) plus a typed IndexProductRequest exposing search()/categorySlug()/sort() accessors
$redirectRoute on IndexProductRequest prevents bounce-back loops on bad filters
Shared product-form component with slotted x-field wrapper carrying @error; hidden is_active=0 input keeps the unchecked state correctly after a failed submit
Small reusable components (price, stock-badge, product-card, flash) using @props and $attributes->class
paginate(12)->withQueryString(), custom pagination view registered via Paginator::defaultView, inline CSS with no build step
Model::shouldBeStrict in non-production; to_route()->with flash; Rule::enum and Rule::unique()->ignore
Pest datasets for authorization matrix, sorts and invalid filters; tests old input, errors next to fields and the flash message rendered on the page

bugs: Unchecked 'Active' checkbox is not preserved after a failed submit: browsers omit unchecked boxes, so old('is_active', $checked) falls back to the model value and re-checks it (resources/views/components/form/checkbox.blade.php:5, product-form.blade.php:28). Confirmed with a probe; the suite's own test masks it by posting is_active=null

Raw search SQL `escape '\'` ("name like ? escape '\\'") is a syntax error on MySQL with default sql_mode because the backslash escapes the closing quote; works only on SQLite/Postgres (app/Models/Product.php:77-78) - portability risk
antipatterns: Collection pipeline built inside the view to make sort options (resources/views/products/index.blade.php:16) - belongs in the controller or enum
Redundant isOutOfStock() check wrapping x-stock-badge, which already branches on it (resources/views/components/product-card.blade.php:7-9)

Ceremony to keep category_id out of $fillable: Category::findOrFail(...)->products()->create() and associate()->fill()->save() spread across controller + productData() (app/Http/Controllers/Admin/ProductController.php:31-33,48-50)
Raw SQL via whereRaw where a plain where('like') would do (app/Models/Product.php:77)
IndexProductRequest has no redirectRoute, so a bad filter redirects back to the previous URL, which can be the same bad URL (probe showed a self-redirect)
strengths: Rich reusable form components (input/select/textarea/checkbox/error) using @props, $attributes->class(['invalid' => ...]), @error, @selected and @checked
@session directive for flash; shared layout; custom pagination view; withQueryString keeps filters
Escapes LIKE wildcards in search and tests it
Price entered in dollars with decimal:0,2 and stored as cents, with the edit form showing the dollar value
getRouteKeyName slug, Rule::enum, #[Scope] attributes, whereBelongsTo/whereKeyNot for related products
Broad Pest datasets for per-field validation and the authorization matrix

v.rationale: Both are well structured, modern Laravel 12 apps: query scopes, FormRequests with prepareForValidation, a resource-route admin area behind a can: middleware, a shared layout, a shared product form and inline CSS. impl-1 has the richer generic form-component library and escapes LIKE wildcards, but it has a real old-input bug: an unchecked 'Active' box comes back checked after a failed submit, because unchecked boxes aren't sent and old() falls back to the model value. Its test hides this by posting null. Its raw `escape '\\'` SQL is also likely to break on MySQL, it builds sort options inside a view, and it adds fillable/associate ceremony. impl-2 handles the checkbox correctly with a hidden 0 input, keeps controllers very thin with typed request accessors, uses redirectRoute for safe filter validation and has a lean slotted field component. Its flaws are minor: unescaped LIKE wildcards, a misnamed viewAny policy and filter errors shown twice. Weighting real bugs heavily, impl-2 ranks first.
